{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent history shows persistent mean reversion toward lower levels, particularly after high volatility.",
    "Apply downward bias correction when sentiment is negative (e.g., -0.25 or below) and model overestimates.",
    "Increase downward adjustment if model consistently overpredicts in early periods of a 30-day window, especially with low sentiment.",
    "Smooth out forecast volatility when sentiment is flat (0.00) by aligning with recent 7-day moving average of true outcomes.",
    "Apply upward bias correction only if sentiment is strongly positive (e.g., +1.00) and historical mean is rising.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude if true outcomes show strong downward drift in the last 5-7 days, regardless of sentiment."
  ]
}
